name: Street Racing
description: Your reputation in the underground racing scene

en.name: Prologue - The Garage
en.intro:
The Miramar sits in the garage, faithful as ever.
Beside it, covered in dust, lies a chassis that once held dreams.
A letter from your grandfather waits on the workbench.
en.completion: This is where it all begins.

es.name: Prologo - El Garaje
es.intro:
El Miramar descansa en el garaje, fiel como siempre.
A su lado, cubierto de polvo, yace un chasis que una vez guardo suenos.
Una carta de tu abuelo espera en el banco de trabajo.

description.heading: Entre Conocidos / Among Friends
description.description: Racing just for the joy of it.

unlocks.heading: Informal Races
unlocks.description: Access to casual races with friends.

en.name: Chapter 1 - Racing Among Friends
en.intro:
It starts without spotlights or applause.
Just old cars, familiar roads, and people racing for the simple joy of it.
A mysterious observer watches from the shadows.
en.completion: Someone is watching. Someone who knows more than they should.

es.name: Capitulo 1 - Carreras entre Conocidos
es.intro:
Todo empieza sin focos ni aplausos.
Solo coches viejos, carreteras conocidas y gente que corre por el simple placer de hacerlo.
Un observador misterioso mira desde las sombras.
es.completion: Alguien te observa. Alguien que sabe mas de lo que deberia.

description.heading: Underground Bajo / Low Underground
description.description: First contact with the illegal scene.

unlocks.heading: Ghost Contact
unlocks.description: Access to underground parts and contacts.

en.name: Chapter 2 - Low Underground
en.intro:
A message from an unknown number changes everything.
Small street races, low stakes, controlled risks.
But the first piece for your project car awaits.
en.completion: Ghost has opened a door. What lies beyond is up to you.

es.name: Capitulo 2 - Underground Bajo
es.intro:
Un mensaje de un numero desconocido lo cambia todo.
Carreras callejeras pequenas, apuestas bajas, riesgos controlados.
Pero la primera pieza para tu proyecto te espera.
es.completion: Ghost ha abierto una puerta. Lo que hay detras depende de ti.

en.name: Chapter 3 - Regional Rallies
en.intro:
Organized events. Real stakes. Your name in the papers.
New faces appear - Techie, Muscle, Import.
A newspaper clipping about The Big One surfaces.
en.completion: Your grandfather's name is spoken again. The past is catching up.

es.name: Capitulo 3 - Rallys Regionales
es.intro:
Eventos organizados. Apuestas reales. Tu nombre en los periodicos.
Nuevas caras aparecen - Techie, Muscle, Import.
Un recorte de periodico sobre The Big One resurge.
es.completion: El nombre de tu abuelo vuelve a sonar. El pasado te alcanza.

unlocks.heading: Shadow Network
unlocks.description: Access to Shadow and high-risk operations.

en.name: Chapter 4 - High Underground
en.intro:
The races are harder. The nights are longer.
Shadow enters the scene. Police heat rises.
Ghost becomes distant. Something is wrong.
en.completion: Lines have been crossed. There's no going back now.

es.name: Capitulo 4 - Underground Alto
es.intro:
Las carreras son mas duras. Las noches mas largas.
Shadow entra en escena. El calor policial aumenta.
Ghost se distancia. Algo no va bien.
es.completion: Se han cruzado lineas. Ya no hay vuelta atras.

unlocks.heading: Federation Events
unlocks.description: Access to official racing federation events.

en.name: Chapter 5 - Official Rallies
en.intro:
Federated events. Technical inspections. The world is watching.
Ghost reappears with a warning.
Your project car is ready... but someone has other plans.
en.completion: Your car is stolen. Everything you built, gone in one night.

es.name: Capitulo 5 - Rallys Oficiales
es.intro:
Eventos federados. Inspecciones tecnicas. El mundo mira.
Ghost reaparece con una advertencia.
Tu proyecto esta listo... pero alguien tiene otros planes.
es.completion: Tu coche ha sido robado. Todo lo que construiste, perdido en una noche.

unlocks.heading: The Big One
unlocks.description: The legendary race your grandfather dreamed of.

en.name: Chapter 6 - Road to The Big One
en.intro:
The truth is revealed. Old wounds are healed.
Qualifying series on circuit.
The definitive race awaits: The Big One.
en.completion: Do it for both of you.

es.name: Capitulo 6 - Camino a The Big One
es.intro:
La verdad se revela. Viejas heridas sanan.
Series clasificatorias en circuito.
La carrera definitiva espera: The Big One.
